stories.title: Norway seizes Russian ship over US$4.2 billion claim by Ukrainian energy firm
stories.summary: Norway had seized a Russian ship in the Arctic to enforce a US$4.22 billion compensation claim won by Ukrainian energy firm Naftogaz over Moscow’s seizure of its assets when Russia annexed Crimea in 2014, officials said late on Wednesday.
